name: POS Closing Shift (Branch)
query:
SELECT
    x.shift_date AS "تاريخ الشيفت:Date:110",

    x.pos_profile AS "Branch:Link/POS Profile:180",

    SUM(x.grand_total) AS "الإيرادات:Float:140",

    MAX(CASE WHEN x.rn = 1 THEN x.visa_amount END)
        AS "بنك CIB فيزا:Float:140",

    SUM(x.total_daily_payments) AS "المصاريف:Float:140",

    SUM(x.total_tip) AS "Tip:Float:120",

    SUM(x.actual_amount) AS "الخزنة:Float:140",

    /* إغلاق الفيزا بعد خصم مبلغ الافتتاح */
    SUM(x.visa_closing) AS "إغلاق الفيزا:Float:120",

    /* إغلاق الكاش بعد خصم مبلغ الافتتاح */
    SUM(x.cash_closing) AS "إغلاق الكاش:Float:120",

    /* فرق الفيزا */
    SUM(x.visa_closing)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN x.rn = 1 THEN x.visa_amount END)
        AS "فرق الفيزا:Float:120",

    /* فرق الكاش */
    SUM(x.cash_closing) - SUM(x.actual_amount)
        AS "فرق الكاش:Float:120"

FROM
(
    SELECT

        /* =========================================
           تحديد يوم الشيفت
           من 9 صباحًا وحتى 4 صباحًا اليوم التالي
           ========================================= */
        CASE
            WHEN TIME(cs.period_start_date) >= '09:00:00'
                THEN DATE(cs.period_start_date)
            ELSE DATE_SUB(
                DATE(cs.period_start_date),
                INTERVAL 1 DAY
            )
        END AS shift_date,

        cs.pos_profile,

        /* الإيرادات */
        COALESCE(cs.grand_total, 0) AS grand_total,

        /* المصاريف */
        COALESCE(
            cs.total_daily_payments,
            0
        ) AS total_daily_payments,

        /* Tip */
        COALESCE(
            cs.total_tip,
            0
        ) AS total_tip,

        /* الخزنة */
        COALESCE(
            cs.actual_amount,
            0
        ) AS actual_amount,


        /* =========================================
           بنك CIB فيزا
           المبلغ المتوقع (Expected Amount)
           من جدول طرق الدفع payment_reconciliation
           وهو المبلغ الظاهر في طباعة الشيفت

           ملاحظة:
           جدول POS Payment Entry Reference فاضي تمامًا
           فتم تحويل المصدر إلى POS Closing Shift Detail
           ========================================= */
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT SUM(
                    COALESCE(pr.expected_amount, 0)
                )
                FROM `tabPOS Closing Shift Detail` pr
                WHERE pr.parent = cs.name
                  AND pr.mode_of_payment = 'بنك CIB فيزا'
            ),
            0
        ) AS visa_amount,


        /* =========================================
           إغلاق الفيزا

           Closing Amount
           ناقص
           Opening Amount

           علشان مبلغ الافتتاح مايتحسبش مرتين
           ========================================= */
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT SUM(
                    COALESCE(pr.closing_amount, 0)
                    -
                    COALESCE(pr.opening_amount, 0)
                )
                FROM `tabPOS Closing Shift Detail` pr
                WHERE pr.parent = cs.name
                  AND pr.mode_of_payment = 'بنك CIB فيزا'
            ),
            0
        ) AS visa_closing,


        /* =========================================
           إغلاق الكاش

           كل طرق الدفع ماعدا بنك CIB فيزا

           Closing Amount
           ناقص
           Opening Amount
           ========================================= */
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT SUM(
                    COALESCE(pr.closing_amount, 0)
                    -
                    COALESCE(pr.opening_amount, 0)
                )
                FROM `tabPOS Closing Shift Detail` pr
                WHERE pr.parent = cs.name
                  AND pr.mode_of_payment != 'بنك CIB فيزا'
            ),
            0
        ) AS cash_closing,


        /* =========================================
           ترتيب شيفتات نفس اليوم ونفس الفرع
           rn = 1 يعني الشيفت الأحدث
           لأن Expected Amount تراكمي
           ويحمل رصيد الشيفت السابق
           ========================================= */
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                CASE
                    WHEN TIME(cs.period_start_date) >= '09:00:00'
                        THEN DATE(cs.period_start_date)
                    ELSE DATE_SUB(
                        DATE(cs.period_start_date),
                        INTERVAL 1 DAY
                    )
                END,
                cs.pos_profile
            ORDER BY
                cs.period_end_date DESC,
                cs.name DESC
        ) AS rn


    FROM `tabPOS Closing Shift` cs

    WHERE
        cs.docstatus = 1

        /* =========================================
           فلترة يوم الشيفت — تاريخ واحد
           يوم الشيفت من 9 صباحًا وحتى 4 صباحًا اليوم التالي
           ========================================= */
        AND
        CASE
            WHEN TIME(cs.period_start_date) >= '09:00:00'
                THEN DATE(cs.period_start_date)
            ELSE DATE_SUB(
                DATE(cs.period_start_date),
                INTERVAL 1 DAY
            )
        END = %(shift_date)s

) x

GROUP BY
    x.shift_date,
    x.pos_profile

ORDER BY
    x.shift_date,
    x.pos_profile
